contributor.name: Hasitha Sandun

contributions.pr_title: Add interactive portfolio generation for GitHub Pages
contributions.pr_body: Introduces a generated portfolio shell that loads contribution data and presents merged PRs with repository context.
contributions.repo_description: CLI tool to curate and showcase open source contributions.
contributions.note: Made generated portfolios easier to publish and share without a custom backend.

contributions.pr_title: Improve package output configuration for library builds
contributions.pr_body: Refines build output naming so CDN consumers can rely on predictable bundle paths.
contributions.note: Reduced confusion for downstream package consumers using CDN-hosted builds.

contributions.pr_title: Document safe markdown rendering in browser integrations
contributions.pr_body: Adds guidance for pairing markdown parsing with sanitization in client-side apps.
